Class World

java.lang.Object
core.World
All Implemented Interfaces:
Renderable, Updatable
public class World extends Object implements Updatable, Renderable
Represents the game world for a single room. Manages the player, all active enemies and projectiles, room dimensions, and background. Handles entity updates, automatic player attacks, score tracking, and rendering.

  • Constructor Details

    • World

      public World(Player player, RoomTemplate roomTemplate, ScoreManager scoreManager)
      Constructs a new world and loads the given room template. Spawns all enemies defined in the template.
      Parameters:
      player - the player character
      roomTemplate - template defining enemy spawns and room properties
      scoreManager - score tracker for kills

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(double dt)
      Updates all entities in the world. Updates player, fires weapons at nearest enemy, updates projectiles/enemies, clamps entities to room bounds, counts kills, and removes dead entities.
      Specified by:
      update in interface Updatable
      Parameters:
      dt - time elapsed since last update in seconds

    • render

      public void render(javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext gc)
      Renders the entire world to the canvas. Draws background, player, projectiles, and enemies in that order.
      Specified by:
      render in interface Renderable
      Parameters:
      gc - graphics context to render to

    • loadRoom

      public void loadRoom(RoomTemplate roomTemplate)
      Loads a new room from the given template. Clears projectiles/enemies, loads background, and spawns enemies with HP scaling. Enemies are placed randomly within room bounds at least SPAWN_MIN_PLAYER_DIST from player.
      Parameters:
      roomTemplate - template defining room properties and spawns
